The hedge fund run by David Gallo held 1.18M shares of the technology company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $188.08M, up from 855,227 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Valinor Management Llc who had been investing in Facebook Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $561.53 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.15% or $2.21 $193.99. About 15.95M shares traded. Facebook, Inc. (NASDAQ:FB) has risen 21.69% uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.12% the S&P500.
